rows.grounds: measure of two parts; accusative object qualifying the pillar
locative indicating the place or extent of projection
prescriptive optative expressing the instructed action
direct object of the prescribed making
compound adverbial indicating dependence on the material; dravya+anusāra+tas

items.question: What material condition determines making the projected pillar two parts?
premises: A pillar is prescribed in the projection.
The pillar can be made with a two-part measure.
The choice of measure follows the nature of the material.
items.inference: Therefore, in the projection the pillar should be made two parts according to the material.
uncertainties: The specific materials that require a two-part measure are not named in this verse.
items.plain_english: In the projection, one should make the pillar two parts, according to the material.
